data.outcome_summary: This OECD TALIS 2024: Netherlands note summarizes questionnaire-based findings for lower secondary teachers and principals collected in 2024. It reports shares/percentages across multiple domains (teachers’ background, teaching for today’s world, student diversity, special education needs, social and emotional skills, technology use including AI, teachers’ learning opportunities, induction/mentoring, continuous professional learning, teacher leadership/autonomy, professional relationships, status of the profession, employment terms, demands of teaching, classroom management, appraisal, professional outcomes, and well-being/retention intentions). The note compares the Netherlands* to an OECD average and highlights statistically significant differences/changes, but it does not provide model-based ML estimation, performance metrics, or PV-based scaling details. The Netherlands is flagged for not meeting participation rate standards, so estimates should be interpreted with caution due to higher risk of non-response bias. The note also states that TALIS relies solely on self-reports, so cross-country comparisons should be interpreted cautiously.
